topic: Impulse-gated large-trade bubbles for Delta Candle Pressure
objective: Show historical large-taker activity on close-confirmed pressure impulses while preserving an exact individual-print mode.

debate.thesis: A confirmed size-bucket taker-flow bubble can make historical large-participant activity inspectable during pressure impulses without changing the pressure state machine.
debate.strongest_support: MMT data.vd supplies historical volume delta for a selected USD trade-size group, and data.volume can locate the dominant same-side profile price when its snapshot is available.
debate.strongest_objection: The hybrid is aggregated net flow rather than individual trades, opposing prints can cancel, the profile anchor is not the large trades' proven execution price, and only 250 initial profile snapshots may be available.
debate.belief_update: IND-002 now defaults to an explicitly labeled historical taker hybrid: data.vd qualifies and signs one aggregate bubble per confirmed impulse bar, data.volume supplies a same-side POC when available, and the candle close is the declared fallback. Exact raw-print mode remains live-edge-only on Free and Pro.

last_query: Implement historical impulse-gated bubbles using large-size data.vd qualification and data.volume price anchoring while retaining exact-print mode.
